title: Childhood memories and the Paris Blues cast
summary: He recalls selling newspapers and swimming as a child, then names Paul Newman, Sidney Poitier and Diahann Carroll as co-stars.

blocks.x: Now, when you were a little boy, beginning life, did you ever wish that you might have become maybe a doctor? No, he wasn't. What are some of the memories you have of New Orleans? I asked you that before, but I like that. Well, the childhood days were very nice.

I mean, we sold newspapers to use the things, and we used to go swimming and play baseball. We used to think like kids did. How do you compare your life here in France with your life in the United States? Well, I was a little older here. I mean, I thought you were talking about when I was a child.

How do you compare my career? I was a kid. I was a kid. I don't do no more in the United States that my wife's with me, you know. Yeah. A young girl there, you know. You can figure it out yourself. Who all is in the Paris movies? Well, I know the stars. I kind of know all the people, you know. But I know Mr. Paul Newman and Sidney Poitier and Diane Cowell. And, well, I'm around them anyway. I mean, they're with them. They, you know, have a little fun, you know. Well, now, you've made movies in the United States. Oh, lots of movies.
